article.story: PRINCETON, N.J. -- — Jackson Hicke's 27 points helped Princeton defeat Yale 76-60 on Saturday. Hicke had five rebounds for the Tigers (6-11, 2-0 Ivy League). Dalen Davis scored 17 points while shooting 5 for 12 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. Jack Stanton finished with 10 points. Nick Townsend finished with 13 points for the Bulldogs (12-3, 1-1). Yale also got 11 points and eight rebounds from Samson Aletan. Trevor Mullin also had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
